user.title: Set up StromGedacht
user.description:
Connect Home Assistant to the StromGedacht API.

Please enter your zip code.

data_description.zip_code: German zip code (5 digits) within the TransnetBW grid area, e.g. 70173.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the data is fetched from the API (minimum 5 minutes).
data_description.short_status: Show only the color as status text (e.g. "Green") instead of the full description.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Please check your internet connection.
error.invalid_zip_code: Please enter a valid 5-digit zip code.
error.no_data_for_zip_code: StromGedacht provides no data for this zip code. Only zip codes in the TransnetBW grid area (mostly Baden-Württemberg) are supported.

abort.already_configured: This zip code is already configured.

init.title: StromGedacht Options
init.description: Configure how often data is fetched and how the status is displayed.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the data is fetched from the API (minimum 5 minutes).
data_description.short_status: Show only the color as status text (e.g. "Green") instead of the full description.
